question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Quell
solution:
The correct answer is: **Suppress**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Quell"** means to put an end to (a rebellion or other disorder), typically by the use of force. It can also mean to subdue or silence someone. (दबाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The police acted swiftly to quell the riot.
 
 

 
• **"Suppress" **refers to forcibly put an end to something or prevent the development, action, or expression of something; it carries a similar meaning to quell. (दबाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The government tried to suppress the facts from becoming public.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **'Quell' **is **'Suppress'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Suppress**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Invite **(आमंत्रित करना): To request the presence or participation of someone.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to invite all her friends to the party.
 
 

 
• **Beseech **(विनती करना ): To ask (someone) urgently and fervently to do or give something.

 
 
• **Example: **He beseeched his colleagues for help in the project.
 
 

 
• **Encourage** (प्रोत्साहित करना): To give support, confidence, or hope to (someone).

 
 
• **Example:** The coach encouraged his players to do their best.
